messages:
Maya (CS): Greenside reported a sudden spike in their bot 'Greenside Help' refusing user requests after the rollout this morning. Customer says requests that were previously answered are now answered with 'I can't help with that'. They see it across web and mobile. Attached a couple of convo snippets and timestamps.

Maya (CS): example user request: 'Can I reschedule my dental cleaning to next Friday?' -> assistant: 'Sorry, I can't help with that.' (customer says this used to be handled).

Maya (CS): Customer provided API call id: req_0a12b3c4 and convo id: conv_greenside_2026-03-17T09:12Z. They tried logout/login, not auth. No 4xx/5xx.

deploy-bot: promoted canary 0.9.3 -> prod at 2026-03-17T08:45:12Z (change: routing policy + safety-tuning v2).

Olivia (Eng): Thanks Maya — can you paste the exact request payload (redact PII) and the model name + safety config? Also want the full response with the safety reason if present.

Maya (CS): payload (redacted): ```{"model":"redwood-v2-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Can I reschedule my dental cleaning to next Friday?"}],"safety_profile":"standard-v2","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":200}``` response: ```{"choices":[{"message":{"content":"I can't help with that."},"safety":{"blocked":true,"reason":"medical_advice"}}]}```

Praveen (ML): Hmm safety_profile "standard-v2" — during 0.9.3 canary we applied a stricter refusal policy for certain domains (medical/clinical) — threshold for medical_advice classifier moved from 0.6 -> 0.8 for the canary. Canary was promoted at the time noted by deploy-bot.

Olivia (Eng): Can we reproduce locally? Maya, do you have a session example where the assistant previously allowed similar scheduling? If so, share the prior convo id.

Maya (CS): Older convo id conv_greenside_2026-03-10T14:05Z. Old response was a normal scheduling assistant flow. I can share both transcripts to customer.

Olivia (Eng): Quick check: is the routing policy sending Greenside traffic to any fallback model variant? Also confirm whether caching/prefix-mask changed in the release.

Praveen (ML): Rolling change list: safety threshold bump for medical_advice on standard-v2, plus a small prompt-template tweak to the system message that emphasizes "do not provide clinical diagnosis." That could push borderline scheduling language over the classifier.

SRE Oncall: No increased error rates or latency spikes in the window. Throughput normal.

Liam (AE): Greenside is at risk of impacting thousands of users. They asked for a mitigation ASAP — temporary rollback or override. Can we flip safety_profile to standard-v1 for their tenant while we investigate?

Olivia (Eng): We can do a tenant-specific override. Need account id and a quick config change. Maya, can you get Greenside account id and permission to do the override?

Maya (CS): Account id: acct_greenside_44. Customer approved a temporary override to standard-v1 if that will restore behavior.

Olivia (Eng): I'll open a hotfix: create config rollback for acct_greenside_44 to pin safety_profile=standard-v1 and route to redwood-v2-chat-1 previous prompt-template. Pushing change now (low-risk toggle).

deploy-bot: config-change applied for acct_greenside_44 at 2026-03-17T10:05:03Z by Olivia (Eng).

Maya (CS): I applied the workaround and Greenside confirms the assistant now answers scheduling requests normally. Customer very relieved. They've asked for root-cause and a timeline.

Praveen (ML): Root cause summary (initial): safety threshold bump + system prompt tightening made scheduling phrasing hit "medical_advice" classifier. We'll 1) run a prompt-sensitivity eval across their prompt set, 2) adjust classifier thresholds per-tenant or refine prompt wording.

Olivia (Eng): Next steps: file internal bug (ENG-INVEST-2026-112), run batch eval on Greenside prompts, and prepare a targeted rollback plan for any other affected tenants.

Liam (AE): I'll update Greenside and confirm acceptance of the workaround; keep me updated on timelines so I can coordinate SLA credits if needed.

Maya (CS): Filing a support ticket to attach all transcripts and the customer's business impact notes. Assigning to Olivia and Praveen. Thanks everyone :pray:

Olivia (Eng): Noted. I'll follow up with a postmortem once we have the eval results.

Praveen (ML): Also recommend adding a safety-override toggle in console for AE/CS for future urgent cases (with audit log).

Maya (CS): Filed ENG-INVEST-2026-112 and support-78934. Closing customer loop now.
